title: Grateful Dead Live at Cafe au Go-Go on 1969-09-30
lineage: AUD > ? > Cass x2 > XLR into SV-3700 > ZA2 > SoundForgeNoise Reduction > CD

ai_review.summary: A historic first China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider show that dazzles despite a rough‑around‑the‑edges audience tape.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its energy and the landmark China > Rider transition, with highlights like an explosive The Other One. Recording quality is inconsistent – most listeners note hiss, muddiness and speed/pitch problems typical of a 1969 AUD, though a few find it surprisingly decent given its age.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the musical performance as excellent or very good (70% weight) while consistently describing the audio as poor to fair (30% weight), resulting in an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Frequent comments about hiss, muddiness, vocal inaudibility, speed/pitch issues and overall roughness; a few note it sounds surprisingly decent for a '69 AUD.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Noted as a short but sweet set with the historic first China > Rider segue and an intense closing The Other One; transitions feel raw yet compelling.
